name: Harvest proven search terms to exact match

explanation.action: Create exact-match keyword in Manual campaign
explanation.optional_action: Add negative-exact search term to source campaign
explanation.reason: Give the proven search term independent bid and budget control while allowing Auto to continue discovering close variations.

notes: A search term cannot be bid on directly. Only a keyword in a manual campaign can.
orders >= 2 is the noise filter: in a 4,088-term sample, 609 terms produced exactly one order and only 132 reached three.
add_negative_to_source is a choice, not a rule. See docs/negative-keywords.md.
The engine will not negate a term into a campaign that is also a harvest destination.
